limitations: Synthetic normalized categorical and scalar arithmetic; not observations of a model or MRI task.

Saved full/strict-label response gradients use different saved reasoning contexts and may omit alternative canonical completion; their dot products cannot substitute for a new same-prefix class contrast.

Mean label score is length-normalized scoring, not the log probability of a completed class event. Sum label score is a joint label-span score; first score is a next-token contrast. None by itself is MRI accuracy.
Negative local margin direction is not a finite-step loss of accuracy or generalization. Counterexamples motivate bounded measurement, not a new loss/training authorization.

measurement_contract.common_context: Same image, native chat prompt and exact answer prefix for both canonical candidates.
measurement_contract.conditioning: Common task-answer prefix and saved Dallasresponse0 reasoning prefix are separate experiments; do not compare candidates with unequal prefixes.
measurement_contract.direction: D M[-g]=-dot(saved actual group_gradient, new margin_gradient). No K/a/r conversion of saved group is needed.
measurement_contract.reuse: Per-candidate gradient(sum)=label_length*gradient(mean). Equality of first and mean gradients is guaranteed for one-token labels; otherwise independently measure first or mark its derivative NOT_MEASURED.
measurement_contract.secondary: M_sum=sum(label logps truth)-sum(label logps alternative); M_first=first truth logp-first alternative logp.
measurement_contract.state: Same original parent weights and numerical policy as saved group gradients; verify state/RNG, strict new scope, no training/generation/update.
measurement_contract.token_boundary: Freeze full rendered prompt/processor-expanded IDs, canonical labels, exact prefix/label/suffix partition; score only declared label tokens, no EOS/suffix salvage.
